Withe atmost Regards Yours Brother in Islam Question: we sometimes pray in grounds that is usually full of lawn (forever green grass), some people say that offering the prayer is not lawfull on this lawn . therefore we kindly repuested you to inlightend the issue send us the respond. Withe atmost Regards Yours Brother in Islam Answer ID: 9883 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 15/15=M/1429) Salah can be performed in lawn provided it is tahir (pure). Those who regard it unlawful, what are their evidences, why do they say so? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
